meta.name: schema-exploration
meta.description: Explore an existing PostgreSQL database before answering questions about its data or writing SQL. Use this skill whenever a user asks for a query or a data-backed answer against an unfamiliar schema (counts, missing or failed records, recent changes), asks where a business concept lives, or asks how tables, joins, views, routines, triggers, RLS, or extensions work. Find the relevant objects with read-only pg_catalog queries, then request approval before inspecting data-derived statistics or rows. Not a schema-design or migration guide.

copy.tagline: 先摸清陌生库的表结构与关联,再回答数据问题或写查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接手一个不熟悉的数据库,却要先回答业务问题或写查询
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherit an unfamiliar database and must answer questions or write queries first

howto.what: 面对不熟悉的 PostgreSQL 库,它先用只读目录查询定位相关的表、视图等对象,在查看数据统计或数据行前会先征求你同意,最后给出带对象名和证据的结论,并区分观察与推断。
howto.when: 当你要针对不熟悉的库提查询或写 SQL,或问某个业务概念存在哪里、表与连接如何工作等时接管。

say.text: 这个库里订单相关的数据在哪些表?先给我对象清单
say.note: 它用只读目录查询列出相关对象

say.text: 帮我写查上月失败记录的 SQL,先确认关联键和粒度
say.note: 它会先厘清连接键再起草查询

say.text: sales.orders 的主键和外键是什么?
say.note: 只读目录元数据,不查数据行

howto.what_en: On an unfamiliar PostgreSQL schema, Claude finds relevant objects with read-only pg_catalog queries, then asks approval before inspecting data-derived stats or rows. Its answers cite schema-qualified objects and separate observations from inferences.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask a query or data-backed answer against an unfamiliar schema, where a business concept lives, or how tables, views, routines, triggers, RLS, or extensions work.

say_en.text: Which tables hold order data in this database? List the objects first.
say_en.note: Read-only catalog queries list relevant objects

say_en.text: Write a SQL query for last month's failed records; confirm join keys first.
say_en.note: It settles join keys and grain before drafting

say_en.text: What are the primary and foreign keys of sales.orders?
say_en.note: Reads catalog metadata only, not data rows
